You may use Search[entity] for an exact encyclopedia title and its first sentences, Lookup[keyword] for the next matching sentence on the current page, and Finish[answer] to end. A failed Search returns candidate titles. On EVERY turn output exactly ONE action on a separate line: Action: Search[entity], Action: Lookup[keyword], or Action: Finish[answer].
